apiCredentials.title: API Credentials
apiCredentials.description: Enter your Meta WhatsApp Business API credentials.
apiCredentials.tokenHiddenNote: Token is hidden for security. Re-enter it to update configuration.
apiCredentials.verifyTokenHint: A custom string you create. Must match the token you set in Meta webhook settings.
apiCredentials.pinHint: Needed only to wire inbound messages for a production number. Set it in Meta Business Manager → WhatsApp Accounts → Phone Numbers → Two-step verification, then paste it here so wacrm can subscribe the number — otherwise Meta routes inbound events to whichever app last claimed it (the symptom that hits second numbers under a shared WABA). Meta test numbers have no PIN and are pre-registered — leave this blank for them. Leaving it blank also keeps an existing registration untouched.

step1.item4: Fill in app details and create

step2.item3: Follow the setup wizard to link your business

step3.title: Get API Credentials
step3.item4: Generate a Permanent Access Token from Business Settings > System Users

step4.title: Configure Webhooks
step4.item3: Paste the Webhook Callback URL from above
step4.item4: Enter the same Verify Token you set here

uazapiConfig.title: Uazapi connection
uazapiConfig.description: Connect a second WhatsApp number via Uazapi (unofficial API). Create the instance and log it into WhatsApp directly in your Uazapi panel first — wacrm only attaches to its token to send messages and receive inbound events via webhook. Runs alongside your Meta connection above; each conversation sticks to whichever provider it started on.

toasts.webhookNotConfigured: Instance attached, but the webhook could not be configured automatically — set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and try again to receive inbound messages.
toasts.attachedNotLoggedIn: Instance attached. It is not logged into WhatsApp yet — log in via the Uazapi panel.

uazapiConfig.confirmDetach: Detach this Uazapi instance from wacrm? Your WhatsApp session in Uazapi stays untouched — you can re-attach the same token any time.

notLoggedIn.title: Token attached, but not logged into WhatsApp
notLoggedIn.description: wacrm saved this token, but Uazapi reports the WhatsApp session isn’t connected. Log the instance into WhatsApp in the Uazapi panel, then click "Refresh status".

form.baseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the server default (https://nuvtex.uazapi.com). Override it if your instance lives on a different Uazapi server or self-hosted URL.
